purpose: Personal account of building and using a Telegram writing assistant

required_facts.fact: Alexey collected background work in Telegram.
The raw stream included voice notes, files, screenshots, and text.
ChatGPT helped refine the workflow and produce summary.md.
Claude Code built the first working version from the specification.
The bot is connected to a GitHub repository.
The /process command processes accumulated material in a batch.
Processing commits changes and sends a commit link to Telegram.
Whisper via Groq transcribes voice messages.
The assistant can translate Russian input into English and process images and links.

author_attribution: This is Alexey's own project and workflow; implementation capabilities are limited to those described in the source.
